title: Released from the Law, The Law and Sin

questions.question: Paul uses an analogy to explain that a person is bound to the law only as long as he lives. Specifically, a married woman is bound by law to her husband while he lives, but what happens if her husband dies?
options: She is released from the law of marriage
She must remain a widow to be considered honorable
She is bound to his brother by the levirate law
She is no longer considered part of the covenant people
questions.correctAnswer: She is released from the law of marriage
questions.explanation: Romans 7:2 (ESV): "For a married woman is bound by law to her husband while he lives, but if her husband dies she is released from the law of marriage."

questions.question: Likewise, Paul says, you also have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to whom?
options: To another, to him who has been raised from the dead
To the Holy Spirit who dwells in you
To the new covenant of grace
questions.correctAnswer: To another, to him who has been raised from the dead
questions.explanation: Romans 7:4 (ESV): "Likewise, my brothers, you also have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to another, to him who has been raised from the dead, in order that we may bear fruit for God."

questions.question: While we were living in the flesh, what were aroused by the law and at work in our members to bear fruit for death?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:5 (ESV): "For while we were living in the flesh, our sinful passions, aroused by the law, were at work in our members to bear fruit for death."

questions.question: But now we are released from the law, having died to that which held us captive, so that we serve not under the old written code but in what?
options: The new life of the Spirit
The freedom of the children of God
The grace that came through Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: The new life of the Spirit
questions.explanation: Romans 7:6 (ESV): "But now we are released from the law, having died to that which held us captive, so that we serve in the new life of the Spirit and not under the old written code."

questions.question: Is the law sin? By no means! Yet, Paul says he would not have known what it is to covet if the law had not said what?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:7 (ESV): "What then shall we say? That the law is sin? By no means! Yet if it had not been for the law, I would not have known sin. For I would not have known what it is to covet if the law had not said, 'You shall not covet.'"

questions.question: But sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, did what in Paul?
options: Produced in him all kinds of covetousness
Made him rebel utterly against God
Showed its true nature as utterly sinful
questions.correctAnswer: Produced in him all kinds of covetousness
questions.explanation: Romans 7:8 (ESV): "But sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of covetousness. For apart from the law, sin lies dead."

questions.question: Paul writes, "I was once alive apart from the law, but when the commandment came..." what happened?
options: Sin came alive and I died
I saw my guilt and wept before God
The wrath of God was revealed
I realized my need for a Savior
questions.correctAnswer: Sin came alive and I died
questions.explanation: Romans 7:9 (ESV): "I was once alive apart from the law, but when the commandment came, sin came alive and I died."

questions.question: The very commandment that promised life proved to be what to Paul?
options: A shadow of things to come
questions.explanation: Romans 7:10 (ESV): "The very commandment that promised life proved to be death to me."

questions.question: For sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 7:11 (ESV): "For sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me."

questions.question: What is Paul's conclusion about the law and the commandment in verse 12?
options: The law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good
The law is spiritual, but we are of the flesh, sold under sin
The law was our guardian until Christ came to justify us by faith
The law is spiritual and good, but weakened by the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: The law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good
questions.explanation: Romans 7:12 (ESV): "So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good."

questions.question: Did that which is good (the law), then, bring death to Paul? By no means! It was sin, producing death in him through what is good, in order that sin might be shown to be sin, and through the commandment might become what?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:13 (ESV): "It was sin, producing death in me through what is good, in order that sin might be shown to be sin, and through the commandment might become sinful beyond measure."

questions.question: Paul laments his internal conflict: "For I do not do what I want, but I do the very thing I ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 7:15 (ESV): "For I do not understand my own actions. For I do not do what I want, but I do the very thing I hate."

questions.question: So now it is no longer I who do it, but what that dwells within me?
options: The old self attempting to rule
The law of death in my members
questions.explanation: Romans 7:17 (ESV): "So now it is no longer I who do it, but sin that dwells within me."

questions.question: Paul states, "For I know that nothing good dwells in me, that is, in my ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 7:18 (ESV): "For I know that nothing good dwells in me, that is, in my flesh. For I have the desire to do what is right, but not the ability to carry it out."

questions.question: Wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death?
options: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord!
The Spirit of life will deliver me in due time!
Only the grace of God can set me free!
God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol!
questions.correctAnswer: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord!
questions.explanation: Romans 7:24-25 (ESV): "Wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death? Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord!..."

key_verse_text: Wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death? Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord!
